noticias_reales.title: Bill Ackman's Pershing Square Made Amazon Its Fourth-Largest Holding by Dumping Alphabet. Here's the Thesis Behind the Switch.
noticias_reales.summary: Ackman's Pershing Square exited its position in Alphabet in the second quarter, with Amazon now accounting for ~10% of the firm's reported holdings. So far, the investment case for Amazon has played out as Ackman expected when he originally bought the stock in April 2025.

noticias_reales.title: Amazon Crossed $3 Trillion. Here's What Comes Next.
noticias_reales.summary: Amazon (NASDAQ:AMZN | AMZN Price Prediction) briefly crossed the $3 trillion market cap threshold in early August.

noticias_reales.title: Amazon's Stock Could Hit $500 by End of 2027. Why AWS Revenue Is the Key.
noticias_reales.summary: Amazon.com stock could be worth $500 a share by the end of 2027 if the company successfully grows its AWS revenue, according to Morgan Stanley.

noticias_reales.title: Two Squeezed Hyperscalers: Does Meta or Amazon Have The Bigger Cash Flow Problem?
noticias_reales.summary: Amazon (NASDAQ: AMZN | AMZN Price Prediction) and Meta (NASDAQ: META) both reported second-quarter results in late July, revealing the same pressure: AI infrastructure is consuming cash.

noticias_reales.title: 3 Stocks the Smart Money Is Quietly Buying in August
noticias_reales.summary: Institutional investors are quietly loading up on three cloud giants even as mega-cap tech cools from its highs, and Berkshire Hathaway's latest disclosure suggests the accumulation is far from over.

noticias_reales.title: Billionaire Stanley Druckenmiller Dumped Micron and Intel, and More Than 11X'd Duquesne Family Office's Stake in an AI Pioneer
noticias_reales.summary: Quarterly-filed Form 13Fs allow investors to track which stocks Wall Street's savviest money managers have been buying and selling. Duquesne Family Office's billionaire chief sent shares of Micron and Intel packing -- and profit-taking is likely only part of the story.

victor_narrative: Sold $716.9B last fiscal year; revenue is growing strongly (+12.4%).
For every $100 in sales, $11 is net profit — profitable.
Generates real cash: $271.3B of free cash flow per year.
Owes $0.16 for every $1 of equity — low debt.
Quick score: 7.3/10, computed from 100 of 100 evidence points — full coverage of all 6 categories.
If it keeps growing as it has and the market pays the same multiple, the stock would be worth ~$324.43 in 12 months (24% above the current price of $262.65).
